svg.title: WAGF illustrative watershed cover
svg.desc: Conceptual illustration, not data: it shows no measured or simulated values. A reservoir with a small dam feeds a river that winds past irrigated fields and a floodplain village. An LLM agent robot at the irrigation headgate and another beside the houses each pass through a small check badge before acting, which stands for rule checks on proposed water decisions. Title: WAGF, Water Agent Governance Framework.

g.text: Rules check LLM agents’ water decisions
